## 4 · Setup script

Paste into the **Setup script** field. Runs once as root before the first
session; the resulting filesystem is snapshotted and reused, so later sessions
start fast.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

VALE_VERSION="3.9.1"
if ! command -v vale >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cd /tmp
  curl -fsSLO --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "https://github.com/errata-ai/vale/releases/download/v${VALE_VERSION}/vale_${VALE_VERSION}_Linux_64-bit.tar.gz"
  tar -xzf "vale_${VALE_VERSION}_Linux_64-bit.tar.gz" -C /usr/local/bin vale
  chmod +x /usr/local/bin/vale
fi

apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gh

@@CLOUD_COREPACK@@

echo "cloud env ready: $(vale --version), $(gh --version | head -1), pnpm $(pnpm -v)"
```

Keep total runtime under ~5 minutes or the snapshot won't build. `pnpm install`
and `vale sync` are **not** here — they belong in `.claude/hooks/cloud-bootstrap.sh`
(installed by `bkit install --auto=claude`) so they re-run on resumed sessions.

## 5 · Verify (first session)

```bash
vale --version && gh --version && pnpm -v
```
